summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval at its Extraordinary General Meeting for its business combination with Pasqal Holding SAS, a French quantum-computing firm. The meeting approved the Incentive Plans and warrant delegation tied to the deal. The registrant acts as the target in a de-SPAC transaction, effectively a strategic review culmination. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed in this excerpt. The deal proceeds under regulatory and shareholder timelines, with the proxy statement dated August 5, 2026. Watch for closing conditions, redemptions, and final merger completion.
